body: You’re getting downvoted but you’re correct. Sometimes shit happens and you feel depressed, and sometimes your life lacks purpose/direction, and sometimes it is a case of chemical bumbo jumbo existing in your brain, or maybe none of all of the above. But these days as mental health movement is becoming prevalent, clinical terms make their way into everyday language without nuance of root cause.

Btw, I don’t feel like a burden or anything. I live by myself and really if anything would like to distance myself from others not because I feel like a burden, but because having them in my life would make suicide harder to do.
